The lighthouse keeper, Elias, had spent forty years tending the light. One morning, after a storm, he found a bottle washed up on the rocks. Inside was a note: "To whoever finds this, I am lost at sea. Please send help." Elias recognized the handwriting. It was his own, from a letter he had written decades ago and thrown into the ocean as a young sailor, a plea for rescue that never came. He had survived, though, and built a life on this shore. The sea had returned his words, not as a cry for help, but as a reminder: he had saved himself long ago. Elias smiled, placed the note back in the bottle, and set it adrift once more. Perhaps, someday, it would find another keeper.
